question: Do authenticated within-donor lesion measurement trajectories reveal divergent lesion growth under the same systemic-treatment change, beyond published best-response rates and known sunitinib interruption anecdotes?
decision_changed: Whether aggregate RECIST SD/PR can conceal treatment-associated divergent lesions sufficiently to justify site-specific monitoring/local-treatment or resistance-biopsy testing in EMC. This is a descriptive design implication, not proven drug efficacy or molecular mechanism.
new_use_required: Actual numerical lesion-level contrast across comparable dated intervals, with evidence beyond original authors conclusions and broad known indolence/heterogeneity. Recovery of a T-DXd response label, published response or source mapping is not a discovery.
prior_art: R6 untreated kinetics/RT donor checks already shelved; untreated primary15.8→18cm arithmetic and concurrentRT+pazopanib lesion shrinkage not new.

R7 sunitinib2012 both source cases already report interruption/reintroduction and dose escalation; generic reversible sensitivity is prior art. Sunitinib2014/pazopanib2019 established response rates/partner association.
R8 adaptation threecabozantinibEMC donors and published one99cycle response; PGR/tamoxifen case and KIT/sunitinib/imatinib cases already described.
R8 T-DXd source has one author-labelled EMC enrollee, linkage pending. FDA panel failed; no revival of antigen/benefit claim.
Prior serial circulating/imaging/fusion sources retain original data/identity/condition limitations.
eligible_sources: Original EMC-labelled clinical sarcoma/precision/phaseI/basket studies, appendices/individual processed tables, or authentic original case series with numerical lesion trajectories. Search exact disease, extraskeletal myxoid/myxoid chondrosarcoma, historical CHN/NR4A3, embedded sarcoma studies and citation trails. Include all identified EMC conditions, not selected responders.

measurement_gate.identity: Source-authenticated EMC NR4A3/fusion strongest. Author-label without molecular evidence separately pending identity; other myxoid/metaplastic/mesenchymal cancers not substituted.
measurement_gate.donor_lesion: Same actual donor and at least two uniquely linked lesions; donor/lesion/site identifiers required, overlapping publications not independent.
measurement_gate.timing: Exact numerical measurements at dated comparable pre/on/off or on/off/rechallenge intervals. A common baseline plus serial lesion observations can support descriptive slopes; no growth-modulation index from treatment durations/categorical SD/PR.
measurement_gate.acquisition: Modality, lesion definition and unidimensional/volumetric units/method comparable or explicitly unverified; source uncertainty/resolution needed for a robust discordance interpretation.
measurement_gate.therapy: Exact systemic/local exposures and changes for each interval; no isolated attribution where radiation/surgery/concurrent changed drugs confound.
measurement_gate.reporting: All eligible lesions and timepoints; new-lesion/non-target progression and reasons for discontinuation retained. No image inspection/digitization during ban, no invented values from drawings.
measurement_gate.comparator: Within-donor simultaneous lesion contrast, not different-patient prior-versus-new therapy rates. Observed association not causal mechanism.
measurement_gate.statistics: Compute only authenticated source arithmetic/rates with actual elapsed dates and comparable dimensions; no pooling incompatible assays, inferred RECIST, precision from plotted pixels, p-value on tiny unverified donors or response proportion from unlinked study groups.

strongest_alternative: Indolent natural history, spontaneous fluctuations or regression, measurement/acquisition differences and thresholding.
Selective target-lesion publication, lesion/site selection, concurrent RT/surgery or therapy dose changes, infection/non-malignant lesions.
Already-described same cases/author conclusions, uncertain subtype and repeated-donor reports.
disproof_and_stop: No suitable source-linked numeric multi-lesion trajectory, or comparisons require invented dates/values/linkage: shelve this standalone question.
Discordance already established by original authors without new useful inference: do not call reanalysis discovery.
Any apparent result fails acquisition/treatment/identity/coverage or ordinary contrary-source checks: stop promotion; one finite follow-up only if exact feasible evidence could resolve value.
coverage: All identifiable relevant EMC conditions in every newly evaluated eligible source plus verified R1–R8 reuse; pending suitable public evidence blocks promotion. Access failure not biological absence.

limits.mode: Quiet API/file work only, active06–10NY computer-use ban; no UI/screenshots/headless/image inspection. No paid/GPU/outreach/publication/PR/externalrecord edits or interrupted content bypass.
limits.owner: Only clinical_measurements path; explicit Codex author/committer; lead alone main/push.
